assets.name: Event Cards
assets.purpose: A set of 24 event cards (silly + everyday) for sorting by likelihood. Foundational for Lessons 1, 2, and 5.
assets.page_layout: Two letter pages, portrait orientation. Each page holds 12 cards in a 3x4 grid. Cards include impossible events (pig flying, snow in July), possible events (rain at recess, friend smile), and certain events (sun rises, lunch served).

image_placeholders.description: Two letter portrait pages of event cards for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Each page holds 12 cards (~2in × 2in) in a 3x4 grid. Each card has a short event sentence and a small icon. Sample events: 'Pig flies' (with pig icon), 'Snow in July', 'Sun rises', 'Friend smiles', 'Lunch served', 'Rain at recess', etc. Thin solid cut-lines between cards.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M1_EVENTS: instructions describe 24 event cards used in lessons 1, 2, 5. Keywords name the visual elements.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 10 sets total (1 set per pair). Each set is 2 pages = 24 cards.
Laminate before cutting for repeated use.
Cut along the grid lines into 24 individual cards per set.
Store each set in a labelled zip-top bag.

assets.name: Likelihood Sort Mat
assets.purpose: A letter-size mat with 3 zones (IMPOSSIBLE, POSSIBLE, CERTAIN) for placing event cards. Used in Lessons 2 and 5.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, landscape orientation. Three zones across the page: IMPOSSIBLE (left), POSSIBLE (middle), CERTAIN (right). Each zone is a labelled rectangle with thick borders.

image_placeholders.description: A landscape likelihood sort mat for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Three zones across the page, each ~3in × 5in: IMPOSSIBLE (left, with a thick red-style outline), POSSIBLE (middle, with a thick yellow-style outline), CERTAIN (right, with a thick green-style outline). Each zone has its label printed at the top in bold.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M2_MAT: instructions describe a 3-zone likelihood sort mat for lessons 2 and 5. Keywords name the visual elements (mat, zones).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 12 mats (1 per pair plus 2 extras). Single page each.
Laminate for dry-erase use.
Distribute one mat per pair.

assets.name: Paper Coin Set
assets.purpose: A set of 12 paper coins with H/T sides for predicting heads/tails. Used in Lessons 3, 4, and 5.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. 12 round coin tokens in a 3x4 grid. Each coin shows H on one side, T on the other.

image_placeholders.description: A 3x4 grid of 12 round paper coin tokens for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Each coin ~2in across with thin solid cut-line. Visible side shows H (heads with a maple leaf or face icon) on each. The reverse side (after flipping) shows T (tails with a different icon). Standard coin proportions.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M3_COINS: instructions describe 12 paper coins for prediction in lessons 3, 4, 5. Keywords name the visual element (coins) and outcomes (heads, tails).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 10 sets (1 per pair). Single page each.
Laminate before cutting.
Cut into 12 individual coins per set.
Glue or tape pairs of coins back-to-back so each is two-sided (H/T).
Store each set in a labelled zip-top bag.

assets.name: Paper Dice Set
assets.purpose: A set of 6 paper dice (foldable) for predicting outcomes. Used in Lessons 3 and 5.
assets.page_layout: Two letter pages, portrait orientation. Each page holds 3 die nets (cube unfolded with 6 faces showing 1-6 dots).

image_placeholders.description: Two letter portrait pages of paper die nets for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Each page holds 3 die nets in a vertical stack. Each die net is a cross-shaped pattern of 6 connected squares with 1 to 6 dots on each face. Fold lines marked dashed; tabs marked solid for gluing. Each net ~3in across.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M4_DICE: instructions describe 6 paper dice for prediction in lessons 3 and 5. Keywords name the visual element (dice, dots).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 6 sets (1 per pair plus 2 extras). Each set is 2 pages = 6 dice.
Cut along solid lines and fold along dashed lines.
Tape or glue tabs to assemble each die.
Store each pair's dice in a labelled bag.

assets.name: Prediction Recording Mat
assets.purpose: A letter-size mat for predicting and recording results in a 2-column table. Used in Lessons 3, 4, and 5.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. Top: title 'My Predictions'. Below: a 2-column 6-row table. Columns: 'Predict' and 'Result'.

image_placeholders.description: A portrait prediction recording mat for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Top: title 'My Predictions' in bold. Below: a 2-column 6-row table. Columns labelled 'Predict' (left) and 'Result' (right). Each cell ~2.5in × 1in for clear writing space. Thin row dividers.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M5_PRED_MAT: instructions describe a prediction recording mat for lessons 3, 4, 5. Keywords name the columns.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 12 mats (1 per pair plus 2 extras).
Laminate for dry-erase use across lessons.
Distribute one mat per pair.

assets.name: Likelihood Lab Template
assets.purpose: A letter-size capstone template with 5 station response areas for the Lesson 5 Likelihood Lab.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. Five station sections stacked vertically. Each section has a small heading and response cells.

image_placeholders.description: A portrait Likelihood Lab template for a Grade 1 capstone, B&W line art. Five station sections stacked vertically (each ~2in tall). Section headings: COIN, DICE, MARBLES, WEATHER, SORT. Each section has 2-3 response cells appropriate for the activity (predict/result for COIN/DICE/MARBLES; single line for WEATHER; column area for SORT).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M6_CAPSTONE: instructions describe a 5-section capstone template for Lesson 5. Keywords name the activity (capstone, lab).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 25 templates (1 per child plus 5 extras).
Stack near the teacher table for distribution.
No lamination needed — single-use summative artifacts.

assets.name: Likelihood Anchor Chart
assets.purpose: A teacher-display anchor chart with the 3 likelihood terms and example events. Posted across all 5 lessons.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, landscape orientation. Three columns: IMPOSSIBLE, POSSIBLE, CERTAIN. Each column has the term, a definition, and 2 example events with icons.

image_placeholders.description: A landscape likelihood anchor chart for a Grade 1 classroom, B&W line art. Three columns labelled IMPOSSIBLE, POSSIBLE, CERTAIN. Each column has: the term in bold, the child-friendly definition (impossible = never, possible = maybe, certain = always), and 2 example events with small icons (e.g., for IMPOSSIBLE: pig flying, snow in July; for POSSIBLE: rain, smile; for CERTAIN: sun rises, lunch).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M7_LIKELIHOOD: instructions describe the likelihood anchor chart for all 5 lessons. Keywords name the three categories.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 copy on letter or scaled to 11x17.
Laminate for repeated reference.
Tape to the front classroom wall before Lesson 1.

assets.name: Predict and Test Chart
assets.purpose: A teacher-display anchor chart of the 4-step cycle: predict, test, record, compare. Posted in Lessons 3, 4, and 5.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. Four numbered steps stacked: 1. PREDICT, 2. TEST, 3. RECORD, 4. COMPARE. Each step has a short sentence and a tiny icon.

image_placeholders.description: A portrait predict-and-test cycle chart for a Grade 1 classroom, B&W line art. Four numbered steps stacked vertically. Each step has a number, the verb in bold, a one-line description, and a tiny icon: 1. PREDICT (with question mark icon), 2. TEST (with magnifying glass), 3. RECORD (with pencil), 4. COMPARE (with two columns). Generous spacing.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M8_CYCLE: instructions describe a 4-step predict-and-test chart for lessons 3, 4, 5. Keywords name the cycle's first two steps.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 copy.
Laminate for repeated reference.
Tape next to the Likelihood Anchor Chart before Lesson 3.

assets.name: Outcome Cards
assets.purpose: A set of 16 event-outcome cards (heads/tails, sun/rain, etc.) for prediction. Used in Lessons 3, 4, and 5.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. 16 cards in a 4x4 grid. Each card shows one outcome with a small icon and label.

image_placeholders.description: A 4x4 grid of 16 outcome cards for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Each card ~1.5in × 1.5in with an icon and label. Cards: HEADS, TAILS, RED, BLUE, SUN, RAIN, SNOW, CLOUD, DOG, CAT, FISH, BIRD, NUMBER 1, NUMBER 2, NUMBER 3, NUMBER 4. Thin solid cut-lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M9_OUTCOMES: instructions describe 16 outcome cards for lessons 3, 4, 5. Keywords name the visual elements.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 10 sets (1 per pair). Single page each.
Laminate before cutting.
Cut into 16 individual outcome cards per set.
Store each set in a labelled zip-top bag.

assets.name: Will It? Maybe! Poster
assets.purpose: A unit anchor poster of Lucky and Mae with the 3 likelihood zones. Posted at the front for the entire unit.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, landscape orientation. Header: 'Will It? Maybe!' Centre-left: Lucky Lou the Loon. Centre-right: Maybe Mae the Cat. Around them: 3 zone badges (impossible, possible, certain).

image_placeholders.description: A landscape unit anchor poster for a Grade 1 likelihood classroom, B&W line art. Header: 'Will It? Maybe!' in big bubble letters. Centre-left: Lucky Lou the Loon (a Canadian loon) holding a magnifying glass. Centre-right: Maybe Mae the Cat (small cat with question-mark vest). Around them, 3 zone badges arranged in an arc: IMPOSSIBLE (red border), POSSIBLE (yellow border), CERTAIN (green border), each with a tiny example icon.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M10_POSTER: instructions describe a unit anchor poster for all 5 lessons. Keywords name the two anchor characters and the unit theme.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 copy on letter or 11x17.
Laminate for the full unit duration.
Tape to the front classroom wall on Day 1.

assets.name: Lucky Puppet
assets.purpose: A paper puppet of Lucky Lou the Loon used by the teacher in the Minds-On phase of every lesson.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. A single full-body cutout of Lucky (~7in tall) with magnifying glass and small detective hat, plus a tab.

image_placeholders.description: A full-body cutout of Lucky Lou the Loon in B&W line art for a Grade 1 teacher puppet, ~7in tall. Lucky is a young Canadian loon (water bird with distinctive black-and-white pattern), wearing a tiny detective hat and holding a magnifying glass over a coin. Bright eyes, confident expression. Rectangular tab at the bottom (~2in wide) for popsicle stick.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image CHAR_LUCKY_FRONT: instructions describe a Lucky Lou puppet for all 5 lessons. Keywords name the character (lucky) and species (loon).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 copy of Lucky on cardstock if possible.
Cut around the outside of Lucky's silhouette including the tab.
Laminate before assembly.
Glue or tape a popsicle stick behind the bottom tab.

assets.name: Maybe Mae Puppet
assets.purpose: A paper puppet of Maybe Mae the Cat used by the teacher in Lessons 2-5 to embody uncertainty and test predictions.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. A single full-body cutout of Mae (~6in tall) with question-mark vest and clipboard, plus a tab.

image_placeholders.description: A full-body cutout of Maybe Mae the Cat in B&W line art for a Grade 1 teacher puppet, ~6in tall. Mae is a young striped cat wearing a vest with a question-mark patch on the chest, holding a small clipboard. Tilted head with a considering expression. Whiskers, big eyes. Rectangular tab at the bottom (~2in wide) for popsicle stick.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image CHAR_MAYBE_FRONT: instructions describe a Maybe Mae puppet for lessons 2-5. Keywords name the character (mae) and species (cat).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 copy of Mae on cardstock if possible.
Cut around the outside of Mae's silhouette including the tab.
Laminate before assembly.
Glue or tape a popsicle stick behind the bottom tab.

overall_prep_notes: Total prep time ~3.5 hours one-time before unit launch (laminating + cutting + assembling dice). Storage: keep all pair sets in labelled zip-top bags. Set up all anchor charts and the unit poster on Day 1. The dice (M4) are the most time-consuming prep — start there.
